name: sub: store invoice
description: Sub-workflow: idempotent invoice insert. Changed payload for an existing key is a conflict, never an overwrite.

nodes.name: Insert invoice if key is new

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO invoices (idempotency_key, source_message_id, source_attachment_id, filename,
                        invoice_number, sender, amount, currency, invoice_data, payload_fingerprint, n8n_execution_id)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::numeric, $8, $9::jsonb, $10, $11)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, payload_fingerprint
)
SELECT 'inserted' AS outcome, id, payload_fingerprint FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT 'existing' AS outcome, i.id, i.payload_fingerprint FROM invoices i
WHERE i.idempotency_key = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins);

parameters.content:
## sub: store invoice
Input: `idempotency_key`, `message_id`, `attachment_id`, `filename`, `invoice` (validated object).
Output: `{ outcome: STORED|DUPLICATE|CONFLICT, invoice_id, reason }`.

One INSERT .. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on the unique `idempotency_key`.
Same key + same fingerprint = DUPLICATE. Same key + changed payload = CONFLICT: the first row is kept, nothing is overwritten.
If the outcome cannot be read (concurrent insert), the node throws; re-running is safe.

main.node: Insert invoice if key is new
